<CLT=cltSYSTEM>It seems you've been
<CLT=cltSTRONG>contradicted<CLT=cltSYSTEM>!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>When this sort of thing happens, you'll go into
a one-on-one debate called a <CLT=cltSTRONG>Rebuttal Showdown<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>What's a Rebuttal Showdown?
For now, let's explain the controls.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>In this mode, you <CLT=cltSTRONG>counter<CLT=cltSYSTEM> the other person's
claim and <CLT=cltSTRONG>argue<CLT=cltSYSTEM> against it...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM><CLT=cltSTRONG>Move your Truth Blade<CLT=cltSYSTEM> with <PAD=【Ｌ３】>
and align it with your opponent's claims.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Perform a <CLT=cltSTRONG>regular cut<CLT=cltSYSTEM> in the direction
the blade is pointing by pressing <PAD=【○】>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Cut with a <CLT=cltSTRONG>Truth Blade<CLT=cltSYSTEM>
by pressing <PAD=【△】>.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>...Oh, sorry, I forgot to tell you.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>In this mode, Truth Bullets
will be called <CLT=cltSTRONG>Truth Blades<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Use regular cuts on your opponent's words,
but when a <CLT=cltSTRONG>weak spot<CLT=cltSYSTEM> appears...
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>slash it with a <CLT=cltSTRONG>Truth Blade strike<CLT=cltSYSTEM>!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Of course, if you don't have the correct Truth Blade,
you will not be able to cut an opponent's remark.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>What's neat is, if you cut through <CLT=cltSTRONG>multiple
words at once<CLT=cltSYSTEM>, you get a time bonus.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Two at once gets you two seconds. Three is 
three... <CLT=cltSTRONG>The more you cut down, the better<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Watch the position of your opponent's claim
closely and slice as many as you can!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>By doing that, you can skew the debate's mood
to your advantage.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>When the mood of the argument is in your favor,
the debate will <CLT=cltSTRONG>progress<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>On the other hand, if you ignore the other person's
remarks, it will skew toward their advantage.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>And then you'll have to deal with
<CLT=cltSTRONG>loss of progress<CLT=cltSYSTEM>...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>If you and your opponent's arguments are
even, a <CLT=cltSTRONG>Blade Lock<CLT=cltSYSTEM> will occur!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>When that happens, you have to mash
<PAD=【○】> as fast as you can to push them off!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Isn't slicing and dicing opinions with a
Truth Sword the bee's knees?

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>What? Not really?
Well, you shouldn't knock it before you try it.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You can also <CLT=cltSTRONG>V Agree<CLT=cltSYSTEM>, so if
blahblahblahblah...
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Thanks for your time!
